_about: Editorial review of data/influence_candidates.json, batch 1 (17 Nov 2026): fossil fuel, tobacco, mining, opioid, and the flagged family and finance senders. A kept entry names the kinds of influence its sentence states, a one-line summary in the atlas voice, and whether the tie ended or met protest. A drop says why. Batch 2 (17 Nov 2026): BMW, Hyundai Motor, Chanel. Candidates not listed here are not reviewed yet and are not shown. check "record" means checked against the record text, not yet against the source page.
